name: d1_tutor_site
request: Make a one-page website for my tutoring service, BrightPath Tutors. I want a big headline with the name, the three subjects we teach - Maths, Physics and English - with a short line about each, our price (5,000 naira per lesson), and a form where parents can leave their name and phone number so I can call them back. After they send it, thank them. Keep what they send so I don't lose it. It has to look good on a phone.
